purpose: Test whether the frozen own-trend plus relative-to-BTC trend mechanism retains alpha when asset selection is performed from a point-in-time, dead-pool-inclusive historical Binance spot-USDT universe rather than a fixed set of today's surviving winners.
scope: Alpha-universe qualification. This experiment does not change or optimize BRRK-0011 and does not use leverage, funding, derivatives, dispersion scaling or new regime predictors.

data.source: Binance public spot daily klines / historical archive discovery
data.lookahead: target computed from completed day t information and held over t+1 return

candidate_universe.source: all mechanically discoverable historical ordinary Binance spot-USDT symbols
candidate_universe.later_inactive_or_delisted_symbols: retained while historical daily rows exist; no current-survival filter
candidate_universe.liquidity_rule: completed-day quote volume at t >= 25000000 USD
mechanical_exclusions: explicit wrapped/synthetic duplicates: WBTC, WETH, WBETH, BETH, BTCB, BTCST, ETHW
candidate_universe.btc_role: BTC is the regime/core asset and is excluded from the alt ranking set

signal.btc_regime: if BTC trend < 0, no alt exposure
signal.btc_beta_budget: existing frozen asymmetric BTC beta, capped at gross 1.0

portfolio_rule.risk_on_core: 50% of available beta budget to BTC and 50% to selected alt sleeve
portfolio_rule.alt_allocation: positive risk-adjusted rank score normalized across selected assets
portfolio_rule.no_eligible_alt: 100% of available beta budget to BTC

placebo.purpose: Test whether cross-sectional ranking adds value beyond the same absolute/relative trend eligibility gate.
placebo.method: For each seed, assign each symbol one fixed pseudorandom priority for the full sample; on each day select the two eligible assets with highest random priority and apply the identical portfolio rule.
placebo.report: full distribution, median, 5th/95th percentiles and fraction beaten by PIT_ALPHA_TOP2_PRIMARY; no placebo winner selection

delisting_exit_stress.base_case: last observed close proxy; a held asset with a missing next daily row receives zero unobserved return and is forced out through the next target update with turnover cost
delisting_exit_stress.interpretation: stress only; includes genuine failures, exchange removals, migrations and ticker replacements, so it is deliberately conservative and not a historical delisting-price estimate

required_outputs: exact daily equity and returns for every registered strategy
exact daily held weights for Top1/Top2/Top3/equal-weight
asset arithmetic contribution and contribution concentration

promotion_requirements: beats the median random-priority Top2 placebo and preferably at least 80% of placebo seeds on Calmar or terminal NAV without materially worse drawdown
does not depend on one asset for more than 50% of positive arithmetic contribution
retains economically meaningful advantage after 10 bps cost and -25% delisting stress
does not collapse in both 2024+ and 2025+ subperiods
includes later inactive assets without making the edge disappear
requires no post-result change to liquidity, age, rank formula, Top-N, BTC core, cap or cost assumptions
primary_decision_rule.failure_action: retain BRRK-0011 fixed-alpha baseline as the research baseline; do not increase model complexity or leverage to rescue PIT alpha

prohibited_posthoc_actions: no changing the 25m liquidity floor after first result
no selecting the best Top-N from the registered family as if it were preregistered primary
no asset-specific signal weights or caps
no removing failed/delisted symbols based on current knowledge
no adding HYPE or another current winner by name
no adding funding, dispersion, covariance, LPM or leverage before interpreting this experiment
no selecting a favorable placebo seed
